source.title: Multi-layered electrode constructs for neural tissue engineering

material: CH–BH layered coating (PVA/PEDOT CH + PVA–GEL biosynthetic hydrogel) on Pt

formulation.evidence:
PVA–Nb and gelatin–Nb were mixed in at 25 : 75 weight
ratio

to produce a 10% w/t solution in Dulbecco’s phosphate
buffer saline
Eosin Y was then added to a final concen￾tration of 0.1 mM

processing.evidence:
photo￾crosslinking via visible light (555 nm) at an intensity of 15 mW
cm2 for 3 min

Samples were kept at 89 1C for
73 hours

, respectively

Samples were kept at 89 1C for
